detailed_descriptions.en: This pack contains 5 woodland weapon skins for the USMC faction. Pointman - M16A4, M27, and M38 Rifles Liana - M39 Enhanced Marksman Rifle Sweep - M249 Light Machine Gun and M240B General Purpose Machine Gun (also available to the USA faction) Palm - M91A1 and M18 Pistols Sage - M32 and M320 (also available to the USA faction) Grenade Launchers These items can be equipped on the Armory screen which can be accessed from the Main Menu. Weapon skins are cosmetic items grounded in reality that don’t impact gameplay. Skins can only be equipped by certain factions and are biome-restricted to keep gameplay authentic. Desert skins show only on desert maps, while woodland skins show on woodland and snow maps.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
This pack contains 5 woodland weapon skins for the USMC faction.

  • Pointman - M16A4, M27, and M38 Rifles

  • Liana - M39 Enhanced Marksman Rifle

  • Sweep - M249 Light Machine Gun and M240B General Purpose Machine Gun (also available to the USA faction)

  • Palm - M91A1 and M18 Pistols

  • Sage - M32 and M320 (also available to the USA faction) Grenade Launchers

These items can be equipped on the Armory screen which can be accessed from the Main Menu.
Weapon skins are cosmetic items grounded in reality that don’t impact gameplay.
Skins can only be equipped by certain factions and are biome-restricted to keep gameplay authentic.
Desert skins show only on desert maps, while woodland skins show on woodland and snow maps.
